description: Whenever a pile of [[poop]] is destroyed, restores half of a [[red heart]].
Grants [[flight]] and gives +3 [[File:Soul Heart.png|link=Hearts#Soul Heart|Soul Heart|alt=]][[:Hearts#Soul Heart|Soul Heart]]s.
Spawns a spider familiar that applies random status effects to enemies it comes in contact with.
Gives +2 [[damage]] and +0.15 [[speed]], and spawns a random [[pill]] upon transformation.

Taking damage has a chance to spawn rock waves. [[File:Dlc r indicator.png|link=|class=dlc cf-tag cf-val-24 |alt=(in Repentance and Repentance+)|Added in Repentance]][[Category:Modified in Repentance]] Isaac can break obstacles by walking over them.

Replaces [[File:Collectible Bum Friend icon.png|link=Bum Friend|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Bum Friend]][[:Bum Friend|Bum Friend]], [[File:Collectible Dark Bum icon.png|link=Dark Bum|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Dark Bum]][[:Dark Bum|Dark Bum]], and [[File:Collectible Key Bum icon.png|link=Key Bum|class=tb-icon tb-link-icon|alt=|Key Bum]][[:Key Bum|Key Bum]] with Super Bum. This bum collects any of the other beggars' pickups, and offers twice the rewards.
Isaac gains a stationary knife that trails directly behind him. It synergizes like [[File:Collectible Mom's Knife icon.png|link=Mom's Knife|Mom's Knife|alt=]][[:Mom's Knife|Mom's Knife]] would.
